items.evidence: Flyway applied V1 through V7 to a clean PostgreSQL 16.13 database.
BPI_ENGINEER received 403; BPI_ADMIN was accepted within tenant, plant and line scope.
Stale publication If-Match returned 409 with currentRevision=7.
The same command key replayed the original response and did not create another retry.
RULE_PUBLICATION_REQUEUED recorded object type RULE_PUBLICATION and revision 7 to 8.
The rules drawer displayed the failed broker error, accepted an operator reason and showed PENDING, total=5, manual=1 and publication r12 without console, page or request errors.

verificationSql: SELECT status,revision,attempt_count,total_attempt_count,manual_retry_count,last_error,last_requeued_at,last_requeued_by FROM bpi.bpi_outbox_events WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND aggregate_id=:rule; SELECT object_type,action,before_revision,after_revision,reason FROM bpi.bpi_audit_events WHERE tenant_id=:tenant AND object_id=:publication_event;
limitations: This acceptance used a local PostgreSQL container and deterministic browser simulator.
PENDING or Kafka PUBLISHED is still not online activation; a later controlled target chain separately proved Flink APPLIED.
Current target capacity and 24-topic cluster smoke pass; this historical retry artifact was not itself rerun.
